**NSXL for Windows**: the console-style home screen, now for your PC games.

### Download
- **`NSXL-Setup-1.0.0.exe`**: installs NSXL with Start menu and desktop shortcuts. Recommended.
- **`NSXL-Portable-1.0.0.exe`**: a single file that runs without installing.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because NSXL isn't code-signed. Choose **More info › Run anyway**.

### What it does
- **Your games in one row.** Installed **Steam** and **Epic Games** titles appear by themselves, using Steam's own artwork. Add anything else, such as an `.exe`, a shortcut or a `steam://` link, in **Settings › Library**.
- **Launches through the right place.** Steam games start through Steam and Epic games through the Epic launcher, so achievements, cloud saves and overlays still work.
- **Play with a controller, keyboard or mouse.** Xbox, PlayStation and Switch Pro controllers work out of the box, and the button icons match whichever one you're holding.
  - Keyboard: arrow keys, Enter (A), Esc (B), + and −, X, Y, Q/E for L/R.
  - F11 switches full screen.
  - The Guide or PS button returns to Home.
- **Everything from the Android version:** Basic White, Basic Black or a live video wallpaper; your page with **play time** for every game; the software menu (+ on a game); SteamGridDB covers; News; an Album of your Windows, Xbox Game Bar and Steam screenshots; interface sounds and ambient music.
- **Made for the couch:** start NSXL with Windows, and sleep, restart or shut down the PC from the Power menu.

### Not on Windows (yet)
The in-game quick menu, Entertainment (streaming apps), NSXL Cloud and in-app controller pairing are Android-only. On PC, the Controllers button opens Windows' Bluetooth settings.

Needs Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit).
